operations.summary: Record the configuration proven to be active after an uncertain deployment result
operations.summary_zh: 部署结果不确定时，记录已确认生效的配置
operations.description: Clears the rollback_failed reconciliation gate only when the named node, tenant scope, source deployment attempt, and observed immutable config all match persisted facts. An operator_confirmed reconciliation of a rollback_failed apply may name a version only when it is that source apply attempt's own config version (the operator verified on the node that it still serves that release) and the attempt's bound configuration artifact still matches its stored digest; another version returns 409 reconciliation_version_not_source and an unverifiable artifact 409 reconciliation_source_unverifiable (reconcile with a null version and publish again). The named version then carries the node's telemetry authorization; the scope's next healthy publication names it as the previous version. A scope reconciled operator_confirmed with a null version may be confirmed once more with the source apply attempt's own version (a supplemental confirmation, audited as edge_config.reconcile_supplement: the operator verified that the source release ran on the node after its rollback failed; the node may serve a later version by then): the request names the same node, scope and source attempt with operator_confirmed. It applies while no reconciliation of that source attempt on the node has named a version since the null one and the source artifact verifies, also after a later deployment of the scope on the node (the null reconciliation lifts the node's hold, so a waiting automatic publication may follow at once) or a reconciliation of another source of the scope; otherwise 409 reconciliation_supplement_not_eligible (including a scope already confirmed with the version; retrying the same request replays it), reconciliation_version_not_source or reconciliation_source_unverifiable. The supplement appends only the reconciliation record: the node state keeps its current and previous versions. The source version enters the node's telemetry authorization, and the scope's next apply command to the node lists it in released_config_version_ids, so the agent sends the access records it held at that version. Every apply command lists the versions an operator_confirmed reconciliation of this node and scope confirmed as a rollback_failed source within the telemetry authorization window. It also permits operator-confirmed recovery of a legacy failed apply only when the deployment artifact, previous identity, fresh mTLS heartbeat pointer chain, missing current/loaded identity, stopped conservative OpenResty projection, and absence of active deployments all agree. That recovery moves only the version pointers; the next healthy publication establishes the current immutable identity. The append-only reconciliation record, live IAM authorization, node-state update, and audit event commit atomically. Retrying with the same Idempotency-Key returns the same fact; changing the payload with that key returns 409.
operations.description_zh: 只有节点、租户作用域、源部署尝试和观测到的不可变配置都与库内记录一致时，才结束 rollback_failed 待对账。回滚失败的 apply 做 operator_confirmed 对账时，只能填这次源部署自己的配置版本（管理员已在节点上核实 它仍在服务这份发布），且该次部署绑定的配置制品仍与存储摘要一致；填其他版本返回 409 reconciliation_version_not_source，制品核不上返回 409 reconciliation_source_unverifiable（改为不填版本对账后重新发布）。 填入的版本随后进入节点遥测授权，作用域下一次健康发布把它作为上一版本。 已按 operator_confirmed 且版本为 null 完成对账的作用域，可以再用源部署自己的版本补充确认一次（审计记为 edge_config.reconcile_supplement，表示管理员核实原部署在回滚失败后曾在该节点运行，节点此时可能已换新版本）： 请求填同一节点、作用域和源部署尝试，resolution 为 operator_confirmed。 条件是此后本节点没有对同一源部署尝试再做过带版本的对账、源制品能核上；本节点在该作用域已有晚于源部署的部署， 或该作用域的其他源部署已完成对账，也可以补充确认（null 对账解除了节点的对账限制，等待中的自动发布可能随即下发）。否则返回 409 reconciliation_supplement_not_eligible （包括已经确认过该版本；同一请求重试按原结果重放）、reconciliation_version_not_source 或 reconciliation_source_unverifiable。 补充确认只追加对账记录，节点状态的当前与上一版本保持不变；源版本进入节点遥测授权，该作用域下一次下发到本节点的 apply 命令在 released_config_version_ids 里列出它，Agent 随后补报按该版本持有的访问记录。每条 apply 命令都会列出遥测授权期内 本节点、本作用域经 operator_confirmed 对账确认为回滚失败源部署的版本。 也允许对旧版失败 apply 做 operator_confirmed 恢复，前提是部署制品、上一身份、最新 mTLS 心跳指针链、 当前/已加载身份缺失、保守的 OpenResty 已停止投影以及没有进行中的部署全部一致；这种恢复只移动版本指针， 由下一次健康发布建立当前不可变身份。追加式对账记录、实时 IAM 授权、节点状态更新与审计事件在同一事务提交。 用同一 Idempotency-Key 重试返回同一事实；同一键改了内容返回 409。
